info.name: AI Learning Platform — Auth API
info.description:
Auth microservice: sign up, sign in, forgot password, reset password.

**Base URL:** Use collection variable `baseUrl` (default: `http://localhost:3001`).

request.description:
Register a new user.

**Request body:**
- `email` (required)
- `password` (required)
- `name` (optional)

**Success (200):** `userId`, `email`, `tokens.accessToken`, `tokens.expiresInSeconds`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — Missing email or password
- `409` — An account with this email already exists

Sign in with email and password.

**Request body:**
- `email` (required)
- `password` (required)

**Success (200):** `userId`, `email`, `tokens.accessToken`, `tokens.expiresInSeconds`.

**Errors:**
- `400` — Missing email or password
- `401` — Invalid email or password

Request a password reset link. If an account exists, an email is sent (or logged in dev).

**Request body:**
- `email` (required)

**Success (200):** `{ "message": "If an account exists, you will receive a reset link." }` (same message whether or not account exists, for privacy).

**Errors:**
- `400` — Missing email

Set a new password using the token from the forgot-password email link.

**Request body:**
- `token` (required) — from the `?token=...` query param in the reset link
- `newPassword` (required)

**Success (200):** `{ "message": "Password has been reset. You can sign in with your new password." }`

**Errors:**
- `400` — Missing token or newPassword
- `422` — Invalid or expired reset link, or user not found
